title: Implement compact duration parsing
instruction: Implement parseDuration(text) in src/duration.mjs. It converts a compact duration into milliseconds. Units are h, m, s and ms. Each unit appears at most once, units appear in descending order (h, m, s, ms), values are non-negative decimal integers, and no whitespace is allowed. Examples: '1h30m' -> 5400000, '45s' -> 45000, '2m500ms' -> 120500, '5ms' -> 5. Throw a RangeError for non-string input, the empty string, a number without a unit, unknown units, whitespace, repeated or out-of-order units.
